data.insight: Carry one accepted model world across listed examples; introduce each on its words, change only what it needs, and join them by redirecting an existing look or route rather than recapping.
data.applies_when: Narration lists several examples of one underlying failure.
data.avoid_when: Examples need different worlds or attributable evidence surfaces.

data.insight: When one line offers two alternatives, hard-cut on the conjunction from the first option held to the second already under way; the jump carries the 'or'.
data.applies_when: Two alternatives in one short narrated line.
data.avoid_when: The actions happen in sequence and a cut would misrepresent causality.

data.applies_when: New generated action inside an established filmed world.
data.avoid_when: No accepted frame shows the needed geography or wardrobe.
